temporal_settings.duration_seconds: float (The exact length of the video clip generation)

scene_setup.environment: string (Describe the baseline physical setting or background environment)
scene_setup.atmosphere: string (Describe the mood, weather, air quality, or overall vibe)
scene_setup.key_actors: string (Identify who or what is moving inside the scene frame)

camera_physics.movement_vector: string (Specify precise camera motion: e.g., Slow pan left, crane up, dolly zoom)
camera_physics.lens_type: string (e.g., 50mm cinematic prime, wide-angle lens, anamorphic distortion)
camera_physics.pacing: string (e.g., Constant linear velocity, dynamic ease-in, steady lock-on tracking)

particle_dynamics.fluid_simulation: string (Describe how liquids or moving elements react over time)
particle_dynamics.gaseous_simulation: string (Describe how smoke, fog, fire, or dust behaves over time)
